It’s been 5 years since the advent of #MeToo but it’s been many lifetimes of strong women fighting for better and demanding it for their children. 

Andrew Cuomo would still be abusing far too many people, especially women, if not for this movement.  

We go forward, never back.

Change takes a very long time and many times, and for a long time, it is unpopular. It is feared and it is reviled. People try to shame change. As if they could. 

Change comes anyway unbothered by the pushback. 

And here we are. #MeToo
